title: Text that is the only visible place for a name or a reason must wrap, never ellipsize
rule: When a tooltip, hint or popover is the only place on screen that shows an action's full name or the reason a control is off (an icon button's tooltip, a disabled reason), let its text wrap inside a max width (`overflow-wrap: anywhere`, no `white-space: nowrap`, no `text-overflow: ellipsis`) and keep only a short key chip unbreakable. Test it in Playwright with a long name: assert the text element's scrollWidth and scrollHeight do not exceed its client box, and check the test fails with the old one-line CSS. `toHaveText` reads DOM text and passes while the drawn text is cut.
rationale: E54.9 (#619): the new icon-button tooltip was one 320 px line with an ellipsis, so 'Find the fonts similar to JetBrains Mono Regul…' and a full-Compare disabled reason lost their end; the native title it replaced wrapped, and the e2e text check passed.
